remarks: "Location is everything!" Sweet studio style living, with nice open floor plan and beautifully updated throughout. Condominium is situated across from historic town green, which makes the perfect place to hang out w/a good read, have a picnic, and enjoy seasonal summer concerts. Very close proximity to so many things...During the warmer months, Calf Pasture Beach is where swimming, boating or simply relaxing, are some of the favorites here. Spend the rest of your time in Historic Sono, which offers so much to do...Variety of award winning eateries, cafes, galleries, shops, breweries, Maritime Aquarium, movie theatre and the impressive SoNo Collection Mall, to name a few. "You will never be bored!" Excellent commuter location with all major highways & Metro North Train only minutes away!! Come check it out...
